articles.title: Car Falls Into Drain After Driver Loses Control On Mani–Mysuru Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A car veered off the road and fell into a roadside drain after the driver allegedly lost control while attempting to give way to a vehicle approaching from behind on the Mani–Mysuru highway. The incident occurred around noon on Tuesday near Peraje.

body.html:
A car veered off the road and fell into a roadside drain after the driver allegedly lost control while attempting to give way to a vehicle approaching from behind on the Mani–Mysuru highway.

The incident occurred around noon on Tuesday near Peraje.

According to eyewitnesses, the car was being driven recklessly and was seen swerving across the road moments before the accident.

A two-wheeler rider travelling behind the vehicle reportedly captured the entire sequence on camera.

Officials said the driver lost control while trying to give way to a tempo traveller coming from behind. The car then hit the roadside drain and finally came to a halt after its front portion reportedly struck the rear side of the tempo traveller.

Fortunately, all passengers inside the car escaped without injuries.

The front portion of the car sustained significant damage, while the tempo traveller also suffered minor damage in the incident.

Authorities said the identity of the car owner has not yet been confirmed.

Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: “Speeding Car Turns Into Missile”: Vehicle Crashes Into House Wall And Electric Pole In Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An overspeeding car crashed into the compound wall of a house before coming to a halt after hitting an electric pole in Bengaluru’s Vinayakanagar, Kodipalya near Kengeri.

body.html:
An overspeeding car crashed into the compound wall of a house before coming to a halt after hitting an electric pole in Bengaluru’s Vinayakanagar, Kodipalya near Kengeri.

According to local residents, the driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle while speeding through the residential area.

The car first rammed into the compound wall of a nearby house and then crashed into an electric pole, triggering panic among residents in the locality.

Despite the severe impact, the driver reportedly escaped with only minor injuries.

Fortunately, no residents or pedestrians were injured in the incident.

Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and began an investigation into the cause of the crash.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: “Robbers Picked the Wrong Man”: Pathankot Victim Fights Back With Bricks After Street Robbery
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking street robbery in Punjab’s Pathankot took a dramatic turn after the victim allegedly fought back against two motorcycle-borne robbers who had snatched his mobile phone and cash. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and has now gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A shocking street robbery in Punjab’s Pathankot took a dramatic turn after the victim allegedly fought back against two motorcycle-borne robbers who had snatched his mobile phone and cash. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and has now gone viral on social media.

According to police and the victim’s statement, the incident occurred when the man was returning home from his shop.

The victim alleged that two men arrived on a motorcycle, blocked his way, and removed the key from his bike to prevent him from escaping. The accused then allegedly snatched his mobile phone and ₹5,000 cash before fleeing from the spot.

After the robbery, the victim reportedly began walking towards his aunt’s nearby house. However, moments later, the same two accused allegedly returned to the area.

Recognising them, the victim allegedly picked up a brick from the roadside and hurled it towards the motorcycle. The brick reportedly struck the accused, causing one of them to lose balance and fall from the bike.

A physical fight then broke out in the middle of the road between the victim and the two accused.

During the scuffle, the robbers allegedly pulled out a datar, a sharp-edged weapon commonly used in Punjab, and threatened the victim. Despite this, the man again threw a brick at them and reportedly injured the accused.

The robbers eventually managed to flee from the scene while allegedly issuing threats to the victim.

Police said a case has been registered based on the victim’s complaint, and efforts are underway to identify and arrest the accused. Officials are also examining CCTV footage to trace the suspects.

The viral video has triggered strong reactions online, with many social media users praising the victim for his courage during the robbery attempt.

articles.title: “Indian Woman Shot Dead Inside US Supermarket”: Gujarat Native Killed in Suspected Robbery Attack
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 45-year-old Indian woman from Gujarat was shot dead during a suspected robbery attempt inside a supermarket in the United States, shocking her family and local community.

body.html:
A 45-year-old Indian woman from Gujarat was shot dead during a suspected robbery attempt inside a supermarket in the United States, shocking her family and local community.

The victim, identified as Meghnaben Patel, had reportedly been working at the supermarket in Virginia for the past 10 years.

According to family members, Meghnaben belonged to Jantral village in Gujarat’s Mehsana district. Her parents still reside in the village.

Disturbing CCTV footage from inside the supermarket, now widely circulating on social media, allegedly shows a masked suspect entering the nearly empty store and approaching the counter where Meghnaben was present.

Moments later, the accused allegedly pulled out a gun and opened fire at close range. Meghnaben collapsed on the spot. The suspect then reportedly jumped over the counter, fired again, and fled from the scene.

Police rushed to the supermarket after receiving information about the shooting and launched an investigation. Authorities have formed special teams to identify and arrest the accused.

Officials have not yet confirmed whether the attack was purely linked to robbery or if another motive was involved.

Meghnaben is survived by her husband, Upendrabhai Patel, and their two children. Her death has triggered grief both in Gujarat and among the Indian community in the United States.

The viral CCTV footage has also sparked widespread discussion online about the safety of immigrants working in retail stores abroad.

#USA #Virginia #Gujarat #IndianWoman #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Woman Throws Ink, Slaps GM Inside Showroom”: Harassment Allegations Rock Maruti Suzuki Dealer
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic scene unfolded inside a Maruti Suzuki showroom in Chhattisgarh’s Bhilai after a woman employee allegedly attacked the General Manager and threw ink on him over accusations of workplace harassment.

body.html:
A dramatic scene unfolded inside a Maruti Suzuki showroom in Chhattisgarh’s Bhilai after a woman employee allegedly attacked the General Manager and threw ink on him over accusations of workplace harassment.

The incident reportedly took place on May 22 at Chauhan Automobiles in Durg district and was captured on video, which is now circulating widely on social media.

According to reports, the woman employee, identified as Amrita Singh, had filed a complaint accusing General Manager Ankit Anand of repeatedly sending obscene messages and making inappropriate remarks.

Police said the incident occurred after a policeman arrived at the showroom following the woman’s complaint.

Viral footage shows the police officer entering the showroom along with Ankit Anand. Moments later, the woman allegedly threw ink on the GM’s face and physically confronted him inside the premises.

The video also shows the policeman attempting to intervene while the woman continued attacking and slapping the accused official.

According to CSP Bhilai Nagar Satyaprakash Tiwari, the woman submitted a written complaint against Ankit Anand, alleging repeated harassment and inappropriate behaviour.

Officials said that after the matter surfaced publicly, several other employees also reportedly came forward with similar allegations against the GM.

Police have launched an investigation into the complaint, and due to the seriousness of the allegations, the case is currently being probed by CSP-level officers.

Further investigation is underway.

#Chhattisgarh #Bhilai #MarutiSuzuki #BreakingNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: “Caught Red-Handed”: Two Women Suspected of Chain Snatching Thrashed by Crowd in Karnataka
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension briefly erupted at the Raybag bus stand in Karnataka’s Belagavi district after two women suspected of attempting to snatch a gold chain were allegedly caught and beaten by members of the public.

body.html:
Tension briefly erupted at the Raybag bus stand in Karnataka’s Belagavi district after two women suspected of attempting to snatch a gold chain were allegedly caught and beaten by members of the public.

According to sources, the incident took place when alert commuters noticed the women allegedly trying to snatch a gold chain at the crowded bus stand.

The suspects, believed to be part of a gang from Miraj in neighbouring Maharashtra, were reportedly caught red-handed during the alleged attempt.

Eyewitnesses said angry members of the public immediately overpowered the two women and allegedly assaulted them at the spot before police intervention.

Following the incident, police reached the area and brought the situation under control.

A case has been registered at Raybag Police Station, and further investigation is underway.

Police are also probing whether the accused women were linked to similar chain-snatching incidents reported in and around the area.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: “Container Truck Rams Car at Toll Plaza”: Kanpur Dehat Crash Leaves One Critical
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major accident was reported late Monday night at the Bara toll plaza in Uttar Pradesh’s Kanpur Dehat district after a speeding container truck allegedly rammed into a car waiting at a toll booth and dragged it for a considerable distance.

body.html:
A major accident was reported late Monday night at the Bara toll plaza in Uttar Pradesh’s Kanpur Dehat district after a speeding container truck allegedly rammed into a car waiting at a toll booth and dragged it for a considerable distance.

Two people travelling in the car sustained injuries, with one of them said to be in critical condition.

The incident took place at toll booth number 11 under the Akbarpur Kotwali area.

According to reports, Ravindra Kumar Mishra, a resident of Etawah district, and Rajesh Singh, a resident of the Gajner area in Kanpur Dehat, were travelling towards Kanpur city in their car.

Police said the car was stationary at the toll booth waiting for the barrier to open when a speeding container truck with a Haryana registration number allegedly crashed into it from behind.

Eyewitnesses claimed the truck driver drove recklessly and dragged the car for a significant distance after the collision, causing severe damage to the vehicle.

After the accident, the truck driver allegedly abandoned the container at the spot and fled.

The incident created panic among toll plaza workers and management staff, who immediately rushed to rescue the injured occupants trapped inside the damaged car.

Both victims were taken to a medical college hospital for treatment.

Officials said Ravindra Kumar Mishra, who was driving the vehicle, suffered internal injuries, while Rajesh Singh, seated in the front passenger seat, sustained serious injuries and was later shifted by family members to a private hospital, where he was admitted to the ICU.

Police have registered the complaint filed by the victims’ family members and launched a search operation to trace the absconding truck driver.

Further investigation is underway.

#KanpurDehat #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #TollPlaza

articles.title: “No Helmet, Alleged Abuse on Road”: Woman Rider Sparks Road Rage Row in Bengaluru
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case of alleged road rage and reckless riding has surfaced from Bengaluru after a woman rider was accused of threatening and verbally abusing a family on the busy 8th Mile Road stretch.

body.html:
A case of alleged road rage and reckless riding has surfaced from Bengaluru after a woman rider was accused of threatening and verbally abusing a family on the busy 8th Mile Road stretch.

According to a complaint shared by a citizen, the incident took place on Sunday while the family was returning to Bengaluru from their hometown.

The complainant alleged that the rider of vehicle number KA-06-HP-1149 was riding aggressively through traffic and was not wearing a helmet during the incident.

The family further claimed that the woman allegedly used abusive language publicly, creating panic and discomfort among commuters present on the road.

Locals at the spot reportedly suspected that the rider might have been under the influence of alcohol. However, authorities have not officially confirmed whether the woman was intoxicated.

The incident has once again raised concerns among residents regarding increasing cases of road rage, rash riding, and traffic rule violations in Bengaluru.

Citizens have urged traffic police and civic authorities to take strict action against irresponsible driving and strengthen enforcement measures to improve commuter safety.

Road safety activists have also repeatedly stressed the importance of helmet use, disciplined driving, and responsible behaviour on public roads to prevent accidents and avoid confrontations.

No official statement regarding police action in the matter has been released so far.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #IndiaNews

articles.title: “SUV Reverses, Runs Over Watchman Twice”: Delhi CCTV Horror Turns Murder Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 60-year-old watchman was allegedly murdered after an SUV driver deliberately ran him over twice in Delhi’s Peeragarhi village in the early hours of Sunday. The deceased was identified as Bijender Bharadwaj, who worked as a watchman at a tempo stand in the area.

body.html:
A 60-year-old watchman was allegedly murdered after an SUV driver deliberately ran him over twice in Delhi’s Peeragarhi village in the early hours of Sunday.

The deceased was identified as Bijender Bharadwaj, who worked as a watchman at a tempo stand in the area.

According to police, a PCR call regarding the incident was received around 4:03 am on May 24, following which a police team rushed to the spot. Bijender was found lying unconscious on the road and was taken to a nearby hospital, where he later succumbed to his injuries.

Police said CCTV footage recovered from the area suggests that the attack was deliberate.

In the footage, the SUV can allegedly be seen standing near the tempo stand with its headlights on for several minutes while Bijender was seated on a chair nearby.

After some time, a man reportedly stepped out of the vehicle carrying a large stick and allegedly attacked the watchman without any provocation.

As the victim tried to escape, the accused allegedly returned to the SUV and rammed the vehicle into him, pushing him into a corner.

Police said the injured watchman then attempted to flee, but the SUV driver allegedly chased him again and ran him over a second time before fleeing the spot.

Investigators also found skid marks at the scene, indicating that the vehicle may have braked before or after the incident.

A case has been registered at Paschim Vihar West police station under Sections 103(1) (murder) and 3(5) (common intention) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Police said the registration number of the SUV is not clearly visible in the CCTV footage, and multiple teams are now scanning nearby CCTV cameras from roads, traffic junctions, and commercial buildings to trace the vehicle and identify the accused.

A relative of the deceased, Sunil Bharadwaj, said Bijender had no known enmity with anyone and had been working as a security guard at the stand for the past year.

“He was a simple man and never fought with anyone,” the relative said.

Further investigation is underway.

#Delhi #Peeragarhi #MurderCase #CCTV #BreakingNews

articles.title: “Rejected After Criminal Past Exposed”: Coimbatore Woman’s House Targeted With Petrol Bombs
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of alleged revenge violence has come to light from Tamil Nadu’s Coimbatore district, where a man and his associates allegedly hurled petrol bombs at a college student’s house after she cut ties with him upon learning about his criminal background.

body.html:
A shocking case of alleged revenge violence has come to light from Tamil Nadu’s Coimbatore district, where a man and his associates allegedly hurled petrol bombs at a college student’s house after she cut ties with him upon learning about his criminal background.

The incident took place near Thondamuthur and was captured on CCTV cameras installed at the house.

According to police sources, the prime accused, identified as Karthik alias Mariappan from Chennai, was known to the woman since her college days. Their friendship reportedly developed into a relationship, but the woman later ended all contact after discovering that multiple criminal cases — including robbery and murder-related offences — were allegedly pending against him.

Police said Karthik allegedly became enraged after the woman refused to continue the relationship.

CCTV footage from the house shows two motorcycles stopping briefly outside the gate before petrol-filled bottles were allegedly thrown into the verandah of the house.

In the video, the first bike is seen arriving outside the residence, after which the pillion rider allegedly throws a petrol bomb into the compound. The explosive lands near a scooter and bicycle parked in the verandah before bursting into flames.

Seconds later, another motorcycle arrives and more petrol bombs are allegedly hurled into the house premises while the fire continues to spread.

Terrified voices, including that of a child, can reportedly be heard in the background as family members rush outside. An elderly man is also seen attempting to move the burning scooter and other vehicles away from the flames.

Fortunately, no injuries were reported in the incident.

Police said the accused and his associates also allegedly abused the woman’s father and issued death threats before fleeing the scene.

Based on a complaint filed by the woman’s father, Thondamuthur police registered an FIR and launched a manhunt for the accused, who are currently absconding.

Investigators are also examining CCTV footage from nearby areas, which allegedly shows the accused carrying petrol-filled plastic bottles and purchasing multiple beer bottles before the attack.

Police said special teams have been formed to trace and arrest all those involved.

Further investigation is underway.

#Coimbatore #TamilNadu #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #CCTV
